summaries.en: Tensions between the US and Iran have peaked as President Trump issued a 48-hour ultimatum to Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz, threatening infrastructure destruction, while Iran fiercely retaliated with warnings of retribution and global economic chaos, declaring "the gates of hell will open for you."
summaries.zh: 美国总统特朗普向伊朗发出48小时最后通牒，要求其开放霍尔木兹海峡并威胁摧毁基础设施，伊朗则立即回击，警告将进行报复并导致全球经济混乱，称“地狱之门将为你们打开”，两国关系因此高度紧张。
